Our Services

Stop Mosquitoes, Ticks & Fleas in Their Tracks

We offer a range of treatment options tailored to your needs — so you can spend your summer relaxing, barbecuing and swimming, instead of hiding from the bugs.

Mosquito Control

Mosquito infestations can cause a constant feeling of dread as you worry about the next time you will be attacked. It is time to enjoy your time outside again.

Watch forBuzzing in your ear, bites after sunset, and mosquitoes every time you step outside.

Tick & Flea

A tick and flea infestation can be a nightmare for homeowners. Ticks can spread Lyme Disease, Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever and Tularemia, while fleas can cause severe allergic reactions to humans and pets.

Watch forPets scratching more than usual, ticks after walks, or flea bites around ankles.

Spotted Lanternfly

This invasive insect has been wreaking havoc across the northeast United States. Our treatments are designed to both eliminate and prevent the Spotted Lanternfly from taking over your property.

Watch forRed-winged insects on trees, egg masses on bark, or sticky honeydew on leaves.

Special Event Sprays

Make sure mosquitoes are not on the guest list. Our one-time Party Spray event treatments keep your outdoor wedding, birthday, graduation party, baby shower or barbecue free of buzzing and biting.

Watch forAn outdoor event coming up — book your Party Spray in advance.
